hypothesis: Long and short decision surfaces need separate score/rank pressure rather than one shared anti_overconstraint filter.

control_variables: same FPMarkets US100 M5 source; same stage267 candidate pool; same MT5 tester identity where available; same report parsing; no selected candidate; no ONNX
